item.title: Alberta’s passenger rail plan faces another delay after missed summer 2025 deadline
item.description: The plan, which will potentially be led by a Crown corporation similar to Ontario's Metrolinx, was said to begin construction as early as 2027.

item.title: Transportation Safety Board investigating train crash that derailed 37 cars in western Alberta
item.description: It is not known what caused the derailment, but CNR said there have been no reports of the cars leaking dangerous goods, or any fires, injuries or impacts on the public.

item.title: 'I just want a gold: Connor McDavid hungry for long-awaited Olympic challenge
item.description: "It’s the biggest sporting event in the world. To do it together with 25 of Canada’s best hockey players is a dream come true, it really is"

item.title: Snow-clearing brushes harm river with microplastics, warn advocates
item.description: Volunteers have collected more than 500 plastic bristles on the bridge this month and since 2019 the group has collected 16,618 bristles and "thousands" of wire fragments.

item.title: Alberta's gambling market will launch before summer but federal efforts could limit sports betting ads
item.description: Alberta is set to launch a new online gambling market before summer but federal efforts to limit or ban sports-betting advertisements could gum up those plans.
